resources.string: Sign in with your existing permitted staff account. Your password and session stay inside this app; no browser is required.
Enter a full phone number with country code. Calls use your internet connection and the configured business caller ID.

Native Android test app. Allow microphone access. Active calls use a foreground notification; tap it to return or end the call. Incoming-call notifications and Bluetooth routing are not included in this build. Sign in again if Android closes the app process.
